```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Post Component</title>
    <link href="https://unpkg.com/tailwindcss@2.29.0/dist/tailwind.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x"></script>
</head>
<body class="bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 font-sans leading-normal tracking-normal overflow-x-auto">
    <div class="container mx-auto p-4">

        <!-- Add a form to create new posts -->
        <form wire:submit.prevent="createPost" class="mb-4">
            <label for="title" class="block text-gray-700 font-semibold mb-2">Title</label>
            <input type="text" id="title" name="title" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md focus:outline-none" wire:model="post.title">

            <label for="content" class="block text-gray-700 font-semibold mb-2">Content</label>
            <textarea id="content" name="content" class="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md focus:outline-none" wire:model="post.content"></textarea>

            <button type="submit" class="bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md">Create Post</button>
        </form>

        <!-- Display list of posts -->
        <div class="mb-4">
            <h3 class="text-gray-700 font-semibold mb-2">Posts</h3>
            @foreach ($posts as $post)
                <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-md shadow-lg mb-2">
                    <h4 class="text-gray-800 font-semibold mb-2">{{ $post->title }}</h4>
                    <p class="text-gray-700">{{ $post->content }}</p>
                    <button wire:click="deletePost({{ $post->id }})" class="bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-semibold py-2 px-4 rounded-md">Delete</button>
                </div>
            @endforeach
        </div>

    </div>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            Alpine.data('PostComponent', {
                post: {
                    title: '',
                    content: ''
                },
                posts: [],

                createPost() {
                    axios.post('/api/posts', this.post)
                        .then(response => {
                            alert('Post created successfully!');
                            this.posts.push(response.data);
                            this.post = {};
                        })
                        .catch(error => {
                            console.error('Error creating post:', error);
                        });
                },

                deletePost(id) {
                    axios.delete(`/api/posts/${id}`)
                        .then(response => {
                            alert('Post deleted successfully!');
                            this.posts = this.posts.filter(post => post.id !== id);
                        })
                        .catch(error => {
                            console.error('Error deleting post:', error);
                        });
                }
            });
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
